fact: A communiqué of 17 March 2026 from the Direction des Titres Fonciers et du Cadastre National sets 30 April 2026 as the deadline for title holders to file originals and pay for the secure electronic title required by the 2025-2026 finance law, with files received at Bujumbura, Gitega, Makamba and Ngozi.
title: Titres fonciers électroniques sécurisés : Entre avancée technologique et inquiétudes sociales
